    StartersBali chicken satayChicken thigh skewers marinated in coconut and turmeric, peanut sauceHow to make it600g chicken thigh fillets, cut into strips200ml coconut milk, for the marinade2 tsp ground turmeric2 stalks of lemongrass100g peanut butter100ml coconut milk, for the sauce2 limes12 bamboo skewersChop the lemongrass and mix with the coconut milk for the marinade and the turmeric. Add the chicken and marinate in the fridge.Soak the skewers in water, then thread on the chicken.Grill until charred and cooked through.Warm the peanut butter with the coconut milk for the sauce and the lime juice into a thick sauce.Beer pong prawn crackersPuffed prawn crackers fried crisp, sweet chilli sauce for dippingHow to make it1 packet prawn crackers1 L vegetable oil, for frying150ml sweet chilli sauceHeat the oil to 190°C.Drop in the prawn crackers a few at a time. They puff up in seconds. Scoop out and drain on paper.Pile into a big bowl with sweet chilli sauce for dipping.Seaweed farm nori crisps with sesame saltGede's family seaweed farmHow to make itAs written, serves 4Nori sheets sandwiched with rice paper, brushed with sesame oil, fried until shatteringly crisp and dusted with toasted sesame, chilli and salt.Brush 6 rice paper sheets lightly with water and press a nori sheet onto each.Cut into 5cm strips.Heat 3cm vegetable oil in a wok to 180°C and fry a few strips at a time for 10 to 15 seconds until they puff and crisp.Drain on paper towel.Toast 2 tbsp sesame seeds in a dry pan and crush with 1 tsp salt and half a tsp chilli flakes.Brush the crisps with a little sesame oil and dust with the sesame salt.MainsGede's seaweed farm nasi gorengWok-fried rice with chicken, garlic and red chilliHow to make it4 cups of cooked jasmine rice, cold400g chicken thighs, diced3 cloves of garlic2 red chillies2 tbsp vegetable oil3 tbsp kecap manis4 eggs1 Lebanese cucumberCook 295g jasmine rice ahead (the day before is best), spread it out and chill. Cold rice fries and holds better.Dice the chicken, crush the garlic, chop the chillies and slice the cucumber.Stir fry the chicken with the garlic and chilli in the oil in a very hot wok.Add the cold rice and kecap manis and toss until smoky.Fry the eggs and serve on top with cucumber slices.Banana leaf snapper with sambal matahThe beach in Bali where Lily falls for GedeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Snapper fillets rubbed with turmeric, chilli, garlic and lime, grilled in banana leaves, topped with a raw lemongrass and eschalot sambal, with coconut rice.Pound 2 garlic cloves, 2 red chillies, 2cm turmeric and the juice of 1 lime into a paste and rub over 4 snapper fillets.Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill or barbecue 10 minutes, turning once.Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice with 200ml coconut milk and water.For the sambal, finely slice 4 eschalots, 2 lemongrass stalks, 2 chillies and 3 makrut lime leaves, mix with 3 tbsp oil, lime juice and salt.Spoon over the fish.SweetsBlack rice puddingSlow-simmered black rice, palm sugar, warm coconut milkHow to make it200g black rice1 L water80g palm sugar, or to taste400ml coconut milk1 pinch sea salt flakesSoak the black rice overnight, which is the resting time.Simmer in the water until thick and soft.Stir in palm sugar to taste.Warm the coconut milk with a pinch of salt and pour over each bowl.DrinksWedding wreckers sunset coolerCoconut water and pineapple juice with mint and lime over iceHow to make it500ml coconut water500ml pineapple juice2 limes1 handful mint leaves2 cups iceFill tall glasses with ice and mint leaves.Pour in the coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime.Stir and serve cold.Bintang with fresh limeA dolphin bit Georgia.
